rows.en: Kweeeeeeeh!! Gyeeeeeeeeh!!
Kiiih~!! Kiiih~...!!
Bogarl spread its arms wide and lunged at Kemjila.
Gyuah!! Gyuoh... Gyu... Gh...
Having finished digesting Kemjila, it bared its fangs at Lodora too.
Gwah... Gi... Ugh... Uuuuh...
Gwoh... Gboh... Ooooh...
What the hell is that thing? It ate both of them...
Its meal finished, Bogarl left the scene without so much as a glance at Ankh and the others.
Bogarl... It's acting even stranger than before.
Bogarl... It's acting even stranger than before!
Damn that Bogarl... It's gone even weirder than before!
Bogarl... It's acting a lot weirder than before.
Bogarl... It's acting far stranger than before.
Bogarl... It's acting far stranger than before.
Bogarl... It's acting far stranger than before, isn't it?
Bogarl... It's acting far stranger than before, isn't it?
Bogarl... It's acting far stranger than before, isn't it?
Bogarl... Something's even more off about it than before.
Bogarl! It's acting even stranger than before!!
Bogarl... It's acting far stranger than before.
Bogarl... It's acting far stranger than before.
Bogarl... It's acting far stranger than before.
Bogarl... Ain't it actin' even weirder than before?
I've only just brought in some lively monsters from the exhibition hall below.
Kiiiih! Kiiiih!
Gyaaaagoooooh!!
Normally I alone would be more than enough to dispose of you, but failure is not permitted.
You lot!! Let's go!!
Th-that I should fall in a place like this... Gwaaaaaaaaah!!
Kiiih... Kiiih...
Gigugu... Gigguuuuuh...
Hmph, how ironic. The leader goes down, and the underlings he dragged along survive...
Fragments of Cell Medals are scattered across the floor.
Hey! Look! A mountain of medals!!
Ankh began digging through the medals piled on the table, searching for his own Core Medals.
There they are!! My Cores!!
But just then!!
Oh no, you don't!?
Gah!!
Tch!! Kazari!! You again...
Kujaku, Condor... Hahahaha!! These are mine now, okay?
And that's not all! Every medal here belongs to me!!
With that, he carelessly grabbed fistfuls of the pile and began absorbing the medals one after another.
Wooooooh... Gwaaaaaaaaaah!!!
Now I just need the Cores you're carrying, and I... I will achieve my complete revival!!!
Kazari...!!
Kazari...!!
Kazari...!!
Kazari...!!
Kazari...!!
Kazari...!!
Kazari...!!
Kazari...!!
Kazari...!!
Kazari...!!
Kazari...!!
Kazari...!!
Kazari...!!
Kazari...!!
Kazari...!!
You idiot! What are you doing!? We're taking this guy down and getting those Core Medals back!!
The Kujaku Core and Condor Core flew out of the fallen Kazari's body!
All right!! We got the Core Medals back!!
Ngh... Just a little more... Just a little more, and I'll be completely revived!!
Wooooooooooooh!!
Waaaaah!!
Tch!! Kazari's still got that much power left...!!
OOO!! Don't let your guard down!! Use these!!
These are...!?
"Kujaku" and "Condor"! Put 'em with your "Taka" and go for a combo!!
All right!! Let's give it a shot...!!
My medals... Mine... Woooooooooooh!!
Here I come!! Kazari!!
Almost... within my reach... A-all of them are mine...
Phew... We did it. This combo is amazing.
OOO, I'm leaving those Core Medals with you. Put them to good use.
Obtained the "Kujaku Medal" and "Condor Medal". OOO can now use a new skill.
Almost... within my reach... A-all of them are mine...
...Good. We got the Core Medals back.

notes.note: Bogal's cry has no established English yet (story_096 #0.26/#0.28 carry the same roar, translated in parallel): used 'Kweeeeeeeh!!'. Align with story_096 if it chose differently.
Unlabelled gurgling right after Lodora's line while Bogal devours it; treated as Lodora's dying sound, not narration.

#0.39-52 is a 14-slot leader block (script TextIdOffset+38+k, speaker shown as party leader); #0.53 is empty, #0.54 is a 15th rough variant. Event chain order 5,14,15,4,6,7,3,11,12,13,1,2,10,9,8 (OOO, Mebius, Zero, W, Nu, Zeta, Den-O, Ultraman, Seven, ?, Rider 1, RX, 00, Wing Zero, God Gundam) does not cleanly match the wording, so voiced by wording only: #0.41 rough (likely Zero), #0.54 'nee ka' (likely Den-O/Momotaros). Bogal referred to as 'it' (glossary g=n).
Rows ending in sentence-final 'na' rendered with a musing tag question to keep them distinct from the plain rows; identical Japanese kept identical.
Branch: script plays #0.18-19 then #0.57-66 (Hiru-Chameleon brings Kemjila and Lodora, fight, defeat). 'Tenjijo' rendered 'exhibition hall'.
Hiru-Chameleon ordering his two monsters into battle.
Unlabelled, but the script sets CHARA_NAME 36 (Ankh) before this line. 'Taicho' rendered 'leader' (Hiru-Chameleon).
??? = Kazari (named two lines later); source's odd '!?' kept.
Core Medal names romanized Kujaku / Condor / Taka, matching the glossary's romanized 'Taka Can'. Not in glossary (Kamen Rider Wiki uses Kujaku (Peacock) / Condor / Taka (Hawk)).
#0.13-27: 15-slot leader block, all identical Japanese -> identical English.
'Baka ga' aimed at the leader for hesitating; 'we' restored as subject of taking Kazari down.
'Yatta' rendered 'We did it' (OOO fought alongside Ankh and the party); could be 'I did it'.
#0.67-68 (and #0.69-70 in story_098) are the alternate ending without OOO in the party; Ankh keeps the medals. #0.67 identical to #0.54 -> identical English.

report: 80/80 rows translated. Uncertain: #0.30 Bogal roar coined (no precedent); #0.39-54 leader variants voiced by wording (chain order unclear); #0.36 gurgle assigned to Lodora; #0.66 speaker Ankh per script; #0.55 'We did it' vs 'I did it'. Not in glossary: Core Medal names Kujaku / Condor / Taka (romanized), 'exhibition hall'.
